evidence.quote: July 27 (Reuters) - Nvidia is in talks to provide roughly $250 billion in financing guarantees for OpenAI as part of a massive data center project, the Wall Street Journal reported ‌on Sunday.
evidence.one_line: Reuters 于 2026 年 7 月 27 日报道，援引《华尔街日报》称，Nvidia 正与 OpenAI 洽谈为数据中心项目提供约 2500 亿美元融资担保。
evidence.speaker: Reuters

evidence.quote: The $250 billion guarantee covers the data center lease ⁠and debt financing, but would not cover the Nvidia chips inside the center, the WSJ said, adding that the chipmaker was also discussing financing OpenAI's chip purchases worth up to $350 billion.
evidence.one_line: 《华尔街日报》称，约 2500 亿美元担保涉及数据中心租赁和债务融资、不包括中心内的 Nvidia 芯片；Nvidia 还在讨论为 OpenAI 提供最高 3500 亿美元的芯片采购融资。
evidence.speaker: Reuters 转述《华尔街日报》

evidence.quote: "I don't know all the details or even how real this is, but if it does happen, I think it's hard to justify for Nvidia," he said.
evidence.one_line: Seaport Research 的 Jay Goldberg 表示，他不了解该安排的全部细节或真实性，但若交易发生，他认为 Nvidia 很难为其合理性辩护。
evidence.speaker: Jay Goldberg，Seaport Research，经 MarketWatch 报道

evidence.quote: Goldberg noted that companies have previously "tripped themselves up with financing customer purchases."
evidence.one_line: Jay Goldberg 指出，公司过去曾因融资支持客户采购而陷入困境。
evidence.speaker: Jay Goldberg，Seaport Research，经 MarketWatch 报道

evidence.quote: Shares of Nvidia lost 5% in Monday's trading.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia 股价在 2026 年 7 月 27 日周一交易中下跌 5%。
evidence.speaker: MarketWatch（Dow Jones）

evidence.quote: According to Jefferies, investors view the proposed arrangement as a prominent example of "circular financing," in which financing provided by a supplier ultimately helps generate demand for its own products.
evidence.one_line: Jefferies 称，投资者将 Nvidia 拟议中的对 OpenAI 融资安排视为循环融资的典型案例。
evidence.speaker: calcalistech.com（转述 Jefferies 的观点）
